description: Taxi id, from the raw file name. Stored as a number, but only a label.
0-based data row in the raw file. With vehicle_id it points back to one raw line.
source: row position in the raw file

description: Time of the point in UTC, used for storage, ordering, and time differences. Differences make sense, ratios do not.
source: DeviceDateTime, read on the device clock (DEVICE_TZ)

description: The same instant in Kosovo local time, used for everything calendar-related (date, hour, weekday).

False when the raw timestamp has minutes only: vehicles 1 and 100 on days 1-12 of each month, where the files were re-saved in a spreadsheet. Several points can then share a timestamp. NA when the timestamp did not parse.
Speed reported by the device. 0 means standing still and 60 km/h is twice 30 km/h, so ratios make sense.
Direction of travel. Circular: the mean of 350 and 10 degrees is 0, not 180.
Digital input 1, binary: the ignition is on (dataset author).
Digital input 2, binary: the taximeter is on (dataset author, from memory; the data agrees). The signal drops out for a few seconds at a time.
Digital input 3, binary: a passenger is in the vehicle (dataset author, from memory). Stuck true most of the time in 25 of the 83 vehicles.
